parameters.query:
=SELECT
  d.id AS draft_id,
  d.idea_id,
  d.keyword_cluster_id,
  d.title,
  d.meta_title,
  d.meta_description,
  d.tags,
  d.content_markdown,
  d.content_html,
  d.word_count,
  d.linkedin_copy,
  d.facebook_copy,
  d.status AS draft_status,
  d.approved_at,
  d.updated_at,
  i.idea_title,
  i.categoria AS idea_categoria,
  i.status AS idea_status,
  k.project_name,
  k.cluster_name,
  k.keyword_principal,
  k.keywords_secundarias
FROM drafts d
LEFT JOIN ideas i ON i.id = d.idea_id
LEFT JOIN keywords k ON k.id = d.keyword_cluster_id
WHERE COALESCE(d.content_markdown, '') <> ''
  {{ $json.body?.draft_id ? "AND d.id = '" + $json.body.draft_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
  {{ $json.body?.idea_id ? "AND d.idea_id = '" + $json.body.idea_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
  {{ $json.body?.keyword_cluster_id ? "AND d.keyword_cluster_id = '" + $json.body.keyword_cluster_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
  {{ $json.body?.project_name ? "AND k.project_name = '" + $json.body.project_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
  {{ $json.body?.status ? "AND d.status = '" + $json.body.status.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "AND d.status IN ('review','approved')" }}
  {{ $json.body?.force ? '' : "AND (COALESCE(d.linkedin_copy, '') = '' OR COALESCE(d.facebook_copy, '') = '')" }}
ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, d.created_at DESC
{{ $json.body?.limit ? "LIMIT " + Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number($json.body.limit))) : "LIMIT 3" }}

messages.content: Eres un copywriter senior B2B especialista en adaptar artículos largos en español neutro a piezas breves para redes sociales. No inventes datos, enfatiza beneficios concretos y mantén coherencia con la marca.

parameters.query:
=UPDATE drafts
SET
  linkedin_copy = COALESCE($2, linkedin_copy),
  facebook_copy = COALESCE($3, facebook_copy),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id, linkedin_copy, facebook_copy, updated_at;
